adversarialReviewOfTheBuild.q: Does the whole-document count of zero Template occurrences on empty-city actually cover the surfaces I did not screenshot?
adversarialReviewOfTheBuild.a: Yes, and that is why it is the strongest evidence here. Every lens and Work section ships in one document and is toggled by class, so the resolved DOM dump covers Assets, Connections, People, Finance, Citizen and the roster lenses in the same measurement, not only the two screenshotted views.

adversarialReviewOfTheBuild.q: Is 'Demo' as the static badge a dishonest fallback?
adversarialReviewOfTheBuild.a: It names no city, and it fails safe: a live city briefly under-labelled as Demo understates, while a fixture pack briefly labelled Live is the exact labelling-gate failure the fixture ruling exists to prevent. A test asserts Live and Staging resolve correctly and that the demo carrier class is toggled off for them.

adversarialReviewOfTheBuild.q: Two ratios now sit two clicks apart, 0 of 7 in the footer and 1 of 12 on Connections. Is that the DEV_PROCESS 1.4 trap?
adversarialReviewOfTheBuild.a: They are different classes, not two measurements of one class, so reconciling them to one number would be the error. They are held apart three ways: different verb (granted vs connected), different denominator, and each carries its counting rule inline at the point of use. The Connections figure gained its rule in this card, which it did not have before.

adversarialReviewOfTheBuild.q: Did anything get worse for the reader?
adversarialReviewOfTheBuild.a: The nav footer is now four wrapped lines in a 248px sidebar instead of one. That is the cost of carrying the counting rule at the point of use, and it is quiet ink at 13px. Named rather than trimmed away.

adversarialReviewOfTheBuild.q: Is anything left that a pack switch does not switch?
adversarialReviewOfTheBuild.a: Yes, and it is named in the close: the browser tab favicon, the SmartSite and Plan Review and Smart Files mounts (foreign products with their own identity), and the gold demo parcel 48021:34137, which is a product-level demo fixture rather than a pack field.

findings.finding: The dispatch forbids the strings Bastrop and Chestnut anywhere in web/ or src/ outside tests. origin/main already carries 15 such occurrences outside tests, in src/adapters.mjs, src/city-pack.mjs, src/fixtures.mjs and src/municode-calendar.mjs.
findings.disposition: Reported, not remediated. Every one of them is a REFUSAL guard: the held clerk host, the identity-hold basis strings, the pack-name rejection, and the fixture leak-detector needles. Deleting them would delete the control the G-74 identity ruling put there. This card introduced zero new occurrences, proven by grepping only the added lines of the diff.
